query: UPDATE tasks SET run_state=CASE WHEN run_pending IS NULL THEN 'queued' ELSE 'uncertain' END,run_error=CASE WHEN run_pending IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object('code',CASE WHEN run_request ? 'execution' THEN 'agent_work_interrupted' ELSE 'agent_model_interrupted' END,'retryable',false) END,run_lease=NULL,run_until=NULL,run_revision=run_revision+1,run_updated=now() WHERE (tenant,id) IN (SELECT tenant,id FROM tasks WHERE run_state='running' AND run_until<now() ORDER BY run_updated LIMIT 20 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
